lines.text: the helicopter turned tail and took its light home. it would tell her everything. let it. i'd come alone.
a glass bridge hung across to the tower next door. sixty floors of nothing underneath. i'd walked worse before.
on top she kept a garden, green behind the glass. palms in the clouds. money grows things. it doesn't make them last.

lines.speaker: goon_b
lines.text: "shoes off on the lawn, cutie. you're dripping on the floor."

lines.speaker: goon_a
lines.text: "let him drip. he won't be dripping anymore."
